fi-polypterus-senegalus.title: Senegal Bichir
fi-polypterus-senegalus.summary: The Senegal bichir, Polypterus senegalus senegalus, is the most widespread bichir, found in 26 African countries including Egypt and Senegal. It is usually found in shallow, slow-moving swamps,…
rows: This species is more widespread than any other bichir and occurs in no less than 26 countries in Africa, incuding Egypt , Cameroon , Ethiopia , Kenya , Mali , Ivory Coast ,…
notes: Floor space is more important than depth with this species.
A soft substrate with pieces of driftwood and smooth rocks arranged to form hiding places is ideal.

fi-polypterus-endlicheri.title: Endlicheri Bichir
fi-polypterus-endlicheri.summary: The saddled bichir, Polypterus endlicheri endlicheri, is a nocturnal bichir recorded from ten African countries including Cameroon, Nigeria and Sudan. It lives in rivers and marshy areas and is…
rows: A widespread species, it has been recorded in Cameroon, Nigeria , Burkina Faso , Ghana , Chad , The Ivory Coast , Mali , Sudan , Benin and the Central African Republic .
notes: Floor space is more important than depth with this species.
A soft substrate with pieces of driftwood and smooth rocks arranged to form hiding places is ideal.
